p: For among the Gentiles the kings often used to sacrifice, as did the priests.
put a word in Balaam's mouth: Taught him what to say.
defy Israel: Cause everyone to hate and detest them.
nations: But shall have religion and laws apart.
dust of Jacob: The infinite multitude, as the dust of the earth.

die the death of the righteous: The fear of God's judgment caused him to wish to be joined to the household of Abraham: thus the wicked have their consciences wounded when they consider God's judgments.
God is not a man: God's enemies are compelled to confess that his government is just, constant, and without change or repentance.
shout of a king is among: They triumph as victorious kings over their enemies.
according to this time it shall: Considering what God will work this time for the deliverance of his people, all the world will wonder.
place: Thus the wicked imagine of God that what he will not grant in one place, he will do in another.
